intro: Build an AI team around your expertise. xPerfect brings reusable specialists, your company’s knowledge and tools, clear jobs, hands-on control and usable results into one workplace. Compare it with the frameworks, control planes and runtimes you can build on.

columns.label: Reuse expertise
columns.example: Save a finance expert with its instructions, reference files and tools.

columns.label: Set the job & outcome
columns.example: Ask for a board brief with an editable forecast and stated assumptions.

columns.label: Work with specialists
columns.example: Let research and finance workers handle separate parts of one job.

columns.label: Watch and steer
columns.example: See progress, add context and redirect work.

columns.label: Choose where it runs
columns.example: Operate the runtime yourself or choose managed hosting.

columns.label: Keep useful results
columns.example: Open the report, spreadsheet, files or structured output.

columns.label: Connect and repeat
columns.example: Connect tools and apps; start work through APIs or schedules.
